Sep 26, 2025

Image 33: Rated 2 out of 5 stars

## No Customer Service
I’ve been very disappointed with my experience using Choppity. I’ve had a few issues with the software, but despite reaching out to the team around four months ago, I’ve received no response at all. The lack of communication is frustrating, especially when projects sometimes corrupt or generate poorly, forcing me to spend extra credits — and ultimately more money — just to fix the errors. Sadly, it feels like a waste of money, and the lack of support has left me with little confidence in the platform. I love the idea and works well for the most part, but the complete lack of customer service is not acceptable.

results.content:
Cons

 Free plan upload limit: Only allows 30 minutes of uploads per month, which may be too low for active creators.
 No offline mode: Requires a stable internet connection to edit, which may cause problems for those working in areas with low internet connectivity.

Choppity AI provides many benefits for video creators. It quickly turns long videos into short clips and makes creating engaging posts easier. However, Choppity has some downsides, such as videos may lag during processing, some advanced edits are limited, and it may not always provide smooth effects or full customization for creative control. [...] Automatic clean-up for language: Choppity detects inappropriate words in your audio and captions and removes or censors them, helping your videos stay suitable for all audiences without manual review. ## Conclusion

To sum up, Choppity AI makes changing long videos into short, shareable clips quick and easy. Its smart editing tools help trim, caption, and style videos with minimal effort. You can save time while keeping your content fresh. Still, it can sometimes lag during large uploads, and some advanced editing features may not be fully met.

This is where a reliable alternative like CapCut Web can make a difference. It provides smooth online editing, creative tools, and multiple export options. It is a strong choice for creators who want to convert long videos into standout shorts without performance issues or feature gaps.
